newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada raw materials prices fall 1.0 pct in Feb.
newsitem.headline: Canada raw materials prices fall 1.0 pct in Feb.

text.p: Statistics Canada on Friday issued the following economic indicators for March, base 1986=100.
INDEX Month pct Yr pct Mar index

The raw materials price index reflects the prices paid by manufacturers for key raw materials. Unlike the industrial product price index, the raw materials price index includes goods that are not produced in Canada.
A Reuters survey of economists had forecast that the overall index would fall 1.4 percent from February.
Statistics Canada said lower prices in March for crude oil, wood and hogs were partly offset by higher prices for copper and wheat.
